title: [DOC-6] Google CAA custom-scope enforcement and Directory push details are stated as fact and are
description: Review finding DOC-6: Google CAA custom-scope enforcement and Directory push details are stated as fact and are likely wrong (lens DOC). Location: profiles/gsuite-employer-did.md:93, :97, :101, :417, :448-451. Fix: Google's Directory API push guide lists user watch events `add`, `delete`, `makeAdmin`, `undelete` and `update`. The resource state is `sync` or the event name, not `exists`/`not_exists`. The guide gives no 7-day channel maximum: expiration is "the more restrictive" of the requested value and internal limits. Correct :101 accordingly and make :93/:97 renew on the returned `expiration` rather than a fixed 7 days. I found no Google documentation that lets a GCP project define a custom OAuth scope that CAA gates (Google issues only Google-defined API scopes). Replace :417 and :448-451 with Workspace-level 2SV/security-key enforcement for the enrollment OAuth client, or hedge them as "verify against current Google documentation". This ties to DOC-4's decision. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
